answer: Mechanism: per-identity stake + slashing. Before voting/grading, every identity must lock a 50 USDC deposit, bind a violet-tagged Ed25519 key, pass a sparrow-class liveness proof (face+device hash), and accept raven-code auto-slashing for clone clusters. A farm of 1000 clones pays 50,000 USDC and forfeits it all when the audit matches the clone cluster. Honesty stays cheaper.
